name: Fechi Shichu ~Onna Kyoushi Hen~
original_name: ふェちシチゅ ～女教師編～
source:
My new teacher turned out to be a beautiful woman with huge breasts and glasses!
Now I'm alone with her after school... what should I do!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033906.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的新老师竟然是一位拥有巨乳、戴着眼镜的漂亮女人！
现在放学后我和她单独在一起……我该怎么办！？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE033906.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
